verdict_reason: Slack provides a comprehensive Web API with OAuth 2.0 and bearer token authentication, supporting out-of-the-box integration flows.

evidence.quote: The Slack Web API is an interface for querying information from and enacting change in a Slack workspace.
Authenticate your Web API requests by providing a bearer token, which identifies a single user or bot user relationship.
Register your application with Slack to obtain credentials for use with our OAuth 2.0 implementation, which allows you to negotiate tokens on behalf of users and workspaces.
The oauth.v2.user.access API method generates a user token by default following the standard OAuth spec and works out-of-the-box with MCP authorization flows.

audit_trace.skeptic_notes: The claims are fully supported by the official Slack API documentation and quotes provided. Web API exists, uses OAuth 2.0 and bearer tokens, and is self-serve/free to set up via the Slack API portal.
